verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot as a built-in "personal AI agent" that users can hand work to: preparing for meetings, analyzing reports, creating project briefs, updating deals by asking, digging into open-ended questions in a full-screen workspace, and routing requests to agents with results delivered back into the workflow. Built-in AI also handles channel and thread summaries and huddle notes with action items. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what actions Slackbot can execute and its permission or approval model, and any independent or hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor marketing one-liners).
